[[File:Harnaidan.jpg|300px|thumb|The Neo-Classical buildings of Harnaidan.]]
'''Neo-Classical''' architecture was an architectural style that flourished on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. The [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Harnaidan]], one of the largest on Muunilinst, featured towering buildings in this style.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Most Neo-Classical buildings were rectangular, with an external colonnade along the sides and a pitched roof.<ref name="CW3">{{CW|3}}</ref> Thanks to its architecture, the city itself was described as a masterpiece of design and art, and some thought of Harnaidan as the antithesis of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] and other such overgrown [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopoleis]].<ref name="DP" /> The city of [[Pilaan]] also contained similar constructions that rose hundred of stories above the ground and were made of [[Marble/Legends|marble]]. Some of the edifices even had precious gems incrusted in their columns.<ref name="RF:T">''[[Rebel Force: Target]]''</ref>
